## The gate

- [ ] `ctest` passes (Debug and Release)
- [ ] `pytest bench -q -W error` passes
- [ ] TPC-H answers match the reference
- [ ] Latency changes measured (Release, 1 warmup + 5 runs, median)
- [ ] Misses unchanged, or the change explained
